blocks.text: O'zbek tilida «Men talabaman», «Opam uyda», «Bugun sovuq» deganda alohida fe'l kerak emas: qo'shimcha (`-man`) yoki hech narsa yetarli. Ingliz tilida esa har bir gapda **fe'l bo'lishi shart**. Shunday gaplarda **be** («bo'lmoq») fe'li ishlatiladi. Hozirgi zamonda uning uch shakli bor: **am**, **is**, **are**. Tarjimada u ko'pincha ko'rinmaydi: I **am** a student — Men talaba**man**; My sister **is** at home — Opam uy**da**.

Tanlash qoidasi oddiy: **I** bilan doim **am**. Bitta kishi yoki narsa (he, she, it, my brother, the room, Tashkent) — **is**. Bir nechta kishi yoki narsa (we, they, my parents, the keys) — **are**. **you** — sen ham, siz ham, sizlar ham — har doim **are** bilan keladi, hatto bitta kishiga gapirganda ham: you **are**, hech qachon «you is» emas.

So'zlashuvda, xat va xabarlarda deyarli doim **qisqa shakl** ishlatiladi: I am → I**'m**, she is → she**'s**, they are → they**'re**. Apostrof (`'`) tushib qolgan harf o'rnida turadi: I **a**m → I'm. Qisqa shakl ism va otdan keyin ham bo'ladi: Tom**'s** at work = Tom **is** at work. To'liq shakl rasmiy matnda va so'zga urg'u berilganda ishlatiladi: «Yes, I **am** ready!» — «Ha, men tayyorman-ku!»
**it's** (= it is) va **its** («uning», egalik) — boshqa-boshqa so'zlar. It**'s** cold — Sovuq; **its** name — uning nomi. Egalik olmoshlari — 60-darsda.

Inkor gap uchun **be** dan keyin **not** qo'yiladi: I am **not**, she is **not**, they are **not**. O'zbekchadagi «emas» ning o'rni ham shunday — kesimdan keyin: talaba **emas**man. **is** va **are** ning qisqa inkori ikki xil: he **isn't** = he**'s not**, we **aren't** = we**'re not** — ma'nosi bir xil. **I** bilan esa faqat bitta: **I'm not** («I amn't» degan shakl yo'q).
Savol shakli (**Are** you ready? **Is** she at home?) va qisqa javoblar (Yes, I am. / No, it isn't.) — keyingi, 2-darsda.
O'zbekcha «-man», «-san», «-dir» qo'shimchalari yoki umuman fe'lsiz aytiladigan gaplarning ko'pi inglizchada **be** bilan quriladi. Eng ko'p uchraydigan holatlar:

items: **yosh**: I**'m** 25. / She**'s** 30 years old. — «25 yoshdaman» (have emas!);
**kasb**: My mother **is** a teacher. — kasb oldida `a` / `an` kerak (65-dars);
**joy**: Dilnoza **is** at home. The bank **is** near the station;
**holat va his-tuyg'u**: I**'m** tired / hungry / cold / afraid / late. — o'zbekchada ko'pincha fe'l: «charchadim», «kechikdim»;
**tavsif**: The flat **is** small but nice. Tashkent **is** big;
**ob-havo va vaqt**: It**'s** cold. It**'s** seven o'clock. — ega sifatida **it** (39-dars).

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I student.» → **I'm a student.** (fe'l ham, `a` ham kerak); «I have 20 years.» → **I'm 20.**; «Is cold today.» → **It's cold today.** (inglizchada ega tushib qolmaydi); «I'm agree.» → **I agree.** — agree o'zi fe'l, unga am qo'shilmaydi (Present Simple — 5-dars).

Uchta qisqa shakl kundalik so'zlashuvda juda ko'p eshitiladi: **that's** = that is («bu ...», «u ...»), **here's** = here is («mana ...»), **there's** = there is («... bor»). there is / there are batafsil 37-darsda o'tiladi; hozircha tayyor ibora sifatida eslab qoling.
Eslab qolish: **I — am**, bitta — **is**, ko'p va **you** — **are**. Inkor — shu fe'ldan keyin **not**.

examples.title: **I am** / **I'm**: talking about yourself
examples.description: **I** bilan doim **am**: o'zbekchadagi «-man» qo'shimchali gaplar. So'zlashuvda ko'pincha qisqa shakl — **I'm**.

sentences.text: **I'm** Aziz, and **I'm** from Samarkand.
Sorry, **I'm** late again.
Today **I'm** at home with my little brother.
**I am** a first-year student at a university in Tashkent.
Thanks, **I'm** fine now, just a bit tired.
Right now **I'm** very hungry and a little cold.
At work **I'm** always busy, but at the weekend **I'm** free.
sentences.translation: Ishda doim **bandman**, dam olish kunlari esa **bo'shman**.

sentences.text: Yes, **I am** ready for the exam!
My name is Madina, and **I'm** twenty-two.
In this photo **I'm** with my parents in Bukhara.

examples.title: He / she / it **is**
examples.description: Bitta kishi yoki narsa (he, she, it, my sister, the room, London) — **is**. Qisqa shakl: **he's**, **she's**, **it's**.

sentences.text: My sister **is** a doctor at the city hospital.
**He's** very tall, but his brother **is** short.
sentences.translation: U juda **baland bo'yli**, akasi esa **past bo'yli**.

sentences.text: **It's** a beautiful day in Tashkent today.
Our teacher **is** from Manchester.
Bekzod **is** at the gym with his friends.
**She's** twenty-five, and **she's** a pilot.
This bag **is** very heavy.
London **is** big, expensive and very busy.
The coffee **is** ready, and the cake **is** on the table.
Mr Brown **is** our new neighbour, and **he's** very friendly.

examples.title: We / you / they **are**
examples.description: Ko'plik va **you** (sen ham, siz ham, sizlar ham) bilan — **are**. Qisqa shakl: **we're**, **you're**, **they're**.

sentences.text: **We're** in the same class at school.
**You're** right, the shop **is** closed.
My grandparents **are** from a small village near Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Bobom va buvim Buxoro yaqinidagi kichik **qishloqdan**.

sentences.text: The apples **are** sweet and very cheap today.
Tom and Sarah **are** students from London.
**They're** at the airport now.
**You are** very kind, thank you!
Dilnoza and I **are** in Samarkand this week.
The children **are** in the garden with the dog.
Your keys **are** in your jacket, not on the table.

examples.title: Age, jobs and places
examples.description: **be** bilan eng ko'p aytiladigan uch narsa: yosh (I'm 20 — «20 yoshdaman», have emas), kasb (`a` bilan: a teacher) va joy (at home, in London).

sentences.text: My grandfather **is** seventy-eight years old.
Madina **is** nineteen, and her brother **is** sixteen.
sentences.translation: Madina o'n to'qqiz **yoshda**, ukasi esa o'n **oltida**.

sentences.text: James **is** an engineer at a big company.
My parents **are** teachers at the same school.
**I'm** a waiter in a café near the station.
Sarah **is** in Paris on business this week.
sentences.translation: Sara bu hafta xizmat safari bilan **Parijda**.

sentences.text: The bank **is** next to the post office.
Today **we're** at home, and the children **are** at school.
My cousin **is** a student in Manchester, and **he's** twenty.
Dr Karimova **is** in room 12 on the second floor.

examples.title: Feelings and states: **I'm** tired, **she's** hungry
examples.description: His-tuyg'u va holat ham **be** + sifat bilan aytiladi: be tired, hungry, cold, afraid, late, angry. O'zbekchada esa ko'pincha fe'l: «charchadim», «sovqotyapman».

sentences.text: **I'm** really tired after work.
The baby **is** hungry again.
**We're** cold — the window **is** open.
Aziz **is** angry with his brother.
My little sister **is** afraid of big dogs.
Sorry, **we're** late — the bus **is** very slow today.
Emma **is** happy because her exam results **are** good.
**It's** hot in the kitchen, and **I'm** thirsty.
The students **are** nervous before the test.
Grandma **is** ill, so **she's** in bed today.

examples.title: Negative: **'m not**, **isn't**, **aren't**
examples.description: Inkor — **be** dan keyin **not**. Qisqa shakllar: I**'m not**, he **isn't** / he**'s not**, they **aren't** / they**'re not**. «I amn't» yo'q.

sentences.text: **I'm not** hungry, thanks.
The museum **isn't** open on Mondays.
My parents **aren't** at home — they're at the market.
This question **isn't** difficult, it's easy.
Tom **is not** English, he's Scottish.
**We're not** in the office today, we're at a conference.
It **isn't** cold today, so the children are in the park.
sentences.translation: Bugun **sovuq emas**, shuning uchun bolalar parkda.

sentences.text: Your answer **is not** wrong, but it **isn't** complete.
Bekzod **isn't** a student any more — he's a programmer.
These shoes **aren't** expensive, and they're very comfortable.
sentences.translation: Bu poyabzal **qimmat emas**, ustiga juda qulay.

examples.title: **That's**, **here's**, **there's**
examples.description: Kundalik so'zlashuvdagi qisqa shakllar: **that's** = that is («bu ...»), **here's** = here is («mana ...»), **there's** = there is («... bor»; batafsil — 37-dars).

sentences.text: **That's** a good idea!
**Here's** your coffee, and **here's** the sugar.
**There's** a bank near the hotel.
**That's** not true — Emma isn't from Oxford.
Great, **here's** the bus at last!
Sorry, **there's** a problem with my phone.
Your room is on the left, and **that's** the bathroom.
Thank you, **that's** very kind of you.
**Here's** my phone number, and **that's** my email.
**There's** a new café on our street, and it's very popular.
sentences.translation: Ko'chamizda yangi kafe **bor**, u juda mashhur.

examples.title: **isn't** ..., **it's** ... — correcting mistakes
examples.description: Tasdiq va inkor yonma-yon — noto'g'ri fikrni to'g'rilash. Aralash mustahkamlash: **am / is / are** va ularning inkori.

sentences.text: Madina **isn't** a doctor, **she's** a dentist.
The capital of Australia **isn't** Sydney, **it's** Canberra.
**I'm not** from Tashkent, **I'm** from Namangan.
The tickets **aren't** in my bag, **they're** in the car.
James and Emma **aren't** brother and sister — **they're** cousins.
Today **isn't** Thursday, **it's** Friday!
My English **isn't** perfect, but **it's** OK for my job.
You **aren't** alone — **we're** all here with you.
That restaurant **isn't** cheap, but the food **is** excellent.
**It's** only seven o'clock, so the shops **aren't** open.
sentences.translation: Soat **hali yetti**, shuning uchun do'konlar **ochiq emas**.
